text: 58-year-old man, crushing substernal chest pain radiating to the left jaw for 40 minutes, diaphoretic. BP 92/58, HR 112. History of diabetes and smoking.
24-year-old woman, sprained right ankle playing soccer 2 hours ago. Can bear weight with pain. Vitals normal. No other injuries.
79-year-old woman, sudden right-sided weakness and slurred speech that started 50 minutes ago. BP 186/98. Takes apixaban for atrial fibrillation.
6-year-old boy, barking cough and low-grade fever overnight. Mild stridor only when crying. SpO2 97%, playful between coughs.
33-year-old woman, 8 weeks pregnant, severe left lower abdominal pain and lightheadedness. BP 88/50, HR 124. Light vaginal bleeding.
45-year-old man, needs a refill of lisinopril; ran out 2 days ago. No symptoms. BP 152/94. Otherwise well.
67-year-old man with COPD, worsening shortness of breath for 2 days, speaking in short phrases. SpO2 84% on room air, RR 30, using accessory muscles.
19-year-old woman, took an unknown number of acetaminophen tablets 6 hours ago after an argument. Currently nauseated, alert, vitals normal.
